newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian late rubber firmer on Tokyo rise.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian late rubber firmer on Tokyo rise.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were firmer in late trading on Wednesday on rises in Tokyo, traders said.
They said March SIR20 rose 0.25 U.S. cents/lb to 53.75 fob Medan and Surabaya and in Palembang, offer prices rose to 53.50 U.S. cents/lb, up 0.25 cents.
In Padang, Pontianak and Jambi, SIR20 prices were unchanged at 53.00, traders said. "It's not too much to say the rises are line with Tokyo uptrend," said one trader.
The trader said he heard a deal was done at 53.75 U.S. cents/lb in Belawan but the quantity was unclear.
Tokyo rubber futures ended up on Wednesday, lifted by short-covering in a move to correct the recent downward trends.
Traders said speculation of Thai government intervention to raise raw material prices was helpful to the Tokyo market.
Indonesian traders said they expected prices to improve further on Thursday even though buyers were still scant.
They said the Thai factor could help local prices to improve. Some said they heard SIR20 was offered at 54.00 U.S. cents/lb in Medan.
"We expect prices to improve tomorrow. But we know that market sentiment is dampened by low demand," said one trader.
Some traders said buyers did not bother to have fresh purchase because they had ample stocks
